summary: Assist Alamosa SAR with recovery on Blanca Peak (10-34)
notes: ART mission 10-34. Subject deceased; cause not stated. AVSAR missions page documents the full June 15-16, 2010 operation (parent-opened): fall ~0900 June 15 on the standard Hourglass route, subject located deceased at ~13,060 ft in a rock band beneath the Hourglass Couloir, recovery June 16; Army Chinook crash-landed during insertion (no serious injuries); Blackhawks flew subject out. CURATION FLAG: row date 2010-06-16 (Alpine recovery mission 10-34) vs occurrence date 2010-06-15; row location 'Blanca Peak' vs Little Bear Peak side under the Hourglass.
